basePrompt: Create an original production-ready 2D game asset as a single independent layer. Preserve the requested perspective and generous safe margins. No copied franchise key art or recognizable official design, no text, no logo, no watermark, no collage, no UI, no frame.
negativePrompt: No official sprite, poster, film still, trademark, character, typography, interface, opaque white canvas, chroma background, contact sheet, multiple alternatives, cropped subject or perspective mismatch.
assembly: Use basePrompt + subject + composition + palette + lighting + perspective + negativePrompt. Delivered generation receipts retain the exact prompt actually sent.
